turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start there.
Don't thank me. Why did a zero go into the gradebook before anyone picked up a phone?
Here is my offer. I will change the zero to 70 percent today if you drop the complaint and we never mention it again.
You're offering me a mark to make a complaint go away, and I'm writing that down. A 70 for a boy with a 91.2 average isn't a correction, Hale. That's the first thing I'll be telling the principal.
Nobody has to know. Do we have a deal?
No. "Nobody has to know" is going in my notes right under the offer. Either the zero comes off on its merits, or I'm in the principal's office at 4:41.
